title: Four Seconds of Net-Mending
subtitle: 电影影像 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 电影影像（文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）
meta: 主题语境：电影影像（文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）　|　核心词汇：detail　|　正文 389 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 detail 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The cinema in our town closed when I was fifteen and reopened the following spring as a club run by six people. My job was the smallest one: sweeping. What I wanted was the film; what I got, for a whole term, was the ① details of everything else — the price of tape, the number of chairs, the name of the man who mended the projector. Every detail of that first week was a number. Mr Rees, who had run the place for thirty years, said no ② detail of a film is worth much until somebody has swept the floor it is shown on.

He was right, though not in the way he meant. We screened a documentary about a fishing village and I watched it eleven times that month, once from the projection box. The ③ detail I remember best is four seconds long: a woman mending a net, her hands moving faster than the sound. No reviewer had described it ④ in detail; the camera simply stayed where it was. 'That,' Mr Rees said, 'is what attention to ⑤ detail looks like when nobody is watching.' Detail, he added, is the only thing a camera cannot invent.

In March the committee asked for a report. I wrote three pages and Mr Rees sent me back to add the ⑥ details of every screening: dates, ticket numbers, the two nights the power failed. I complained that nobody would read them. 'Somebody always wants you to ⑦ go into detail,' he said, 'usually the person you least want to.'

By summer I was allowed to choose the Tuesday programme. I chose badly at first — long films, dark films, films I liked — and the room emptied. What filled it again was a season of short documentaries, each about a single trade, each one ⑧ detailed in the notes I pinned in the foyer: who made it, how long it took, what went wrong. People, I discovered, will forgive a bad film, but not a bad ⑨ detail in the notes.

Mr Rees retired in August. ⑩ For further details, his last notice said, apply to the secretary — a joke, since he had been the secretary for thirty years. I have the job now, and I still sweep. The film, I have learned, is the part you can see; everything else is what holds it up.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 细节；细微之处
B. n. 具体情况；细目（常用复数 details）
C. v. 详细说明；逐一列举（detail sth）
D. 固定搭配：in detail 详细地
E. 固定搭配：attention to detail 对细节的关注
F. 固定搭配：go into detail 深入细说；逐一详述
G. 固定搭配：for further details 欲知详情；更详细的情况
H. n. （画面、图像的）细部；局部

items.q: what attention to detail looks like
wants you to go into detail
each one detailed in the notes
not a bad detail in the notes

answers.why: 指票价、椅子数、修机人姓名等“具体情况、细目”，故用复数 details。
指影片的“细节”，与 sweeping 对照，说没扫地的影院谈细节无意义。
指画面中四秒钟的“细部、局部”——补网的那个镜头。
in detail 意为“详细地”，指没有影评人细述过这个镜头。
attention to detail 意为“对细节的关注”，Rees 先生以此评价镜头。
指每场放映的“具体细目”：日期、票数、停电的两晚。
go into detail 意为“深入细说”，此处说总有人要求你细讲。
detail 作动词，意为“详细说明”，此处用被动：每部片都在门厅的简介里被逐一说明。
指简介里写错的“细节”，说观众能原谅烂片但不能原谅错信息。
for further details 意为“欲知详情”，是告示上的套语，而他自己就是秘书，故成笑话。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 整整一学期，我得到的都是别的事情的具体情况。（details）
我记得最清楚的那个细部只有四秒钟。（detail）
没有影评人详细地描述过它。（in detail）
他让我把每场放映的细目补上。（details）
每部纪录片都在门厅的简介里被逐一说明。（detail v.）
欲知详情，请与秘书联系。（for further details）
answers: For a whole term what I got was the details of everything else.
The detail I remember best lasts only four seconds.
No reviewer had described it in detail.
He made me add the details of every screening.
Each documentary was detailed in the notes pinned in the foyer.
For further details, please apply to the secretary.

answers: My first job at the cinema was sweeping, so for a whole term I dealt with the details of everything except the film.
